source_note: Calibrated from PRJ-ryskulov-mektubu's own uploaded scene plan (Görsel ve ton ilkesi / Prodüksiyon Notları): archive-document facsimiles, abstract data visualization, period-document texture, empty/silent geography - no reenactment, no human bodies, no depiction of death or violence. Extends style/archaeological_abstract_documentary.json's forbidden-list/disclosure mechanism for a mass-death historical subject.
grade: cool grey and faded sepia, low saturation, measured and heavy but not horror-dark - restrained gravitas, not dramatized dread
grain: period paper/photograph texture where appropriate (foxing, faint creases), otherwise clean and unstylised
texture_language: typewriter type on aged paper (illegible/abstract glyphs, never real invented text), official seal or carbon-copy texture, manila archive-folder paper, faded watermark, empty steppe/road/flat horizon photography with no human figure in frame
forbidden: any graphic depiction of death or violence
reenactment or dramatization of a historical scene
readable chart labels, readable numbers, data tables, infographic text, axis labels, or any invented legible text baked into the image
required_prompt_suffix: no people, no corpses, no readable text, no chart labels, no numbers, documentary archival aesthetic, muted and restrained, not sensationalized --style raw
ai_generated_disclosure: Every AI-generated image used in the published video must carry the on-screen label "üretilmiş görsel — belgesel değildir" - hard requirement per the same disclosure principle used in style/archaeological_abstract_documentary.json, applied here given the sensitivity of the subject matter even though this project's own source PDF was not confirmed (in this session) to state the rule verbatim.
sensitivity_rationale: Subject is a real, documented mass-death event (Kazakh famine / Aşarşılık, 1930-1933, genocide-adjacent). Source material's own 'Hassasiyet uyarısı' explicitly bans any depiction of corpses/starvation bodies/execution and mandates data/document-focused restraint over dramatization - this style profile is the direct code-level encoding of that rule.
